title: Event program
idea: Event program: Real date and place lead into a time-based program with sessions, access and booking conditions.
audience: People who need to plan attendance within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: The event has a concrete schedule and attendance requirements.
avoidWhen: Schedules or participants are unconfirmed but appear final.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic timeline layout through its plan attendance priority and explicit commitment contract: Label provisional sessions and confirm date/time zone before reservation.
navigation: Event program keeps the current plan attendance context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Real date and place lead into a time-based program with sessions, access and booking conditions.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to plan attendance; the event has a concrete schedule and attendance requirements.
composition.priority: Label provisional sessions and confirm date/time zone before reservation.

imagery.role: Support the actual plan attendance context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Use a local-time list with clear day headings rather than tiny horizontal tracks.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the event program structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no plan attendance content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Label provisional sessions and confirm date/time zone before reservation.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized plan attendance content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Label provisional sessions and confirm date/time zone before reservation.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active plan attendance context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
